chunks: Al-Husayn ibn ʿUbayd Allah informed me, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya, from his father, from Muhammad ibn ʿAli ibn Mahbub, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan, from Jaʿfar ibn Bashir, from Ismaʿil al-Juʿfi, from Abi Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

Concerning blood that is on a garment: if it is less than the measure of a dirham, then he does not repeat the salat (prayer). If it is more than the measure of a dirham and he had seen it but did not wash it until he prayed, then he must repeat his salat (prayer). But if he had not seen it until he prayed, then he does not repeat the salat (prayer).

key_terms.الثَّوْبِ: the garment or clothing worn in salat (prayer)
key_terms.قَدْرِ الدِّرْهَمِ: the measure of a dirham used here as a legal threshold
key_terms.يَغْسِلْهُ: washes the blood from the garment

ai.seo_question: Does blood on clothing invalidate salat (prayer), and when must the prayer be repeated?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding blood on clothing during salat (prayer). It distinguishes between a small amount and a larger amount, and also between intentional neglect after seeing it and unawareness of it before praying.
